## Requirements: Pages Phase 2-A — source-backed Agent runs and Issue activity

### Context and explicit prerequisites

Child of #1782, Phase 2-A. **Unblocked** by the existing read-only data sources: #1702 (Issue-selected E2E), #1692 (canonical Agent runs), #1737 (Agent workflow telemetry), #1240 (repository metrics) and #1728 (post-merge Agent reconciliation) are closed. **#1690 remains an explicit non-prerequisite** for this public-only metrics slice; immutable orphan integrity and raw store browsing are out of scope. #1799 is a dependency only for claiming trustworthy historical Case SC verdicts, which this issue does not do.

Canonical source: the already-published `metrics/agent-metrics.json` schema v1 provides 7d/30d `runs.total`, `runs.by_provider`, `runs.by_workflow`, `runs.by_issue`. The current Pages MVP already consumes `agent-metrics.json` in `pages/scripts/project.mjs`. No raw records or unauthenticated runtime requests are required.

### Scope

Extend the independent `pages/` public projection and Pages UI only:
- Agent view: present **source-backed** 7d/30d workflow run totals and a bounded aggregation by provider/workflow, with observed totals and explicit coverage/missing state; no fabricated cost attribution, "online" claims or per-provider success conclusions.
- Collaboration view: alongside recently updated public Issues only, show source-backed **7d observed Agent runs for the Issue number** when `runs.by_issue[number]` is present. Missing observation is `Not observed` rather than `0`; these counts are not Issue→PR exact-SHA join proof.
- Show source generated-at, `metrics_sha` (when supplied) and measurement-window labels. Leave stale/absent data marked unavailable and never silently reuse a different window.
- Version/allowlist the public projection contract; bound map cardinalities, numbers, label lengths and reject private metadata.
- Own styling, presentation, tests, code and build exclusively under `pages/`. Do not import/copy any `web/` design token, UI component, asset or hook.
- Retain the existing `pages-overview` E2E ID as a regression test. Do not change the Issue-based E2E catalogue ID.

**Explicit exclusions:** No inferred PR↔Agent causality, no real-time Agent presence, no full Case verdict projection, no raw Event/Provider records, no orphan audit assertion. Those belong to later Phase 2-B/3 work after #1799 and #1690 respectively.

### Success Criteria

- [ ] SC-01 The Agents view shows observed 7d/30d run counts by canonical workflow and provider, with source window and timestamp, bounded deterministic ordering and N/A for missing observation.
- [ ] SC-02 The Collaboration view shows source-backed 7d observed Agent run counts for individual public Issues when present, never a false zero, exact-SHA join, Owner/Stage inference or completion claim.
- [ ] SC-03 The build-time public projection exposes only strict schema-versioned allowlisted data with bounded maps and source SHA, and never raw prompts, tool inputs, secrets or host/session identifiers.
- [ ] SC-04 Positive/negative deterministic tests cover 7d/30d values, absent/mismatched window, malicious Issue titles/map keys, negative/NaN counts, stale sources, and unknown-vs-zero semantics.
- [ ] SC-05 Independent Pages browser E2E verifies new Agent and Issue observations with responsive/deep-link behavior; `web/` design, components and build stay independent.
- [ ] SC-06 CI Quality/E2E/Acceptance on exact PR HEAD succeeds; public site source remains purely read-only, with future Case provenance drilldown explicitly flagged as unavailable.
